findingDetails.title: Orphan-sweep kill switch remains bypassable through the library surface

claimAdjudication.claim: A direct applySweep call with opts.enabled omitted does not honor the documented switch.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: A direct caller forwarding the switch or an explicit CLI-only API contract.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The switch may intentionally apply only to the CLI entry point.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: An explicit opt-in contract or fail-closed library default.

findingDetails.title: Plan-time parent-pid gate leaves freshly orphaned daemons alive

claimAdjudication.claim: A daemon whose parent dies between planSweep and applySweep is not reaped by that apply.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: A transition test or explicit second-pass contract.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: Refusing stale parent evidence is conservative against false positives.

findingDetails.title: cli-devin still contains a contradictory permission-mode authority

claimAdjudication.claim: A playbook reader can still conclude smart is invalid after packet 058.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: A 3000.2.17 qualifier or proof of a narrower environment parser.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The precondition preserves the old baseline, but it is unqualified.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Version-scope old-value statements and prove a narrower parser.

findingDetails.title: Phase 3 completion claims lack a tracked negative-control artifact

claimAdjudication.claim: Phase 3 is marked complete without durable proof of the same hung run terminating at the bound and naming its handle.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: A checked-in fixture, captured output, or linked evidence record.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: A manual run happened outside the repository, but no durable command/output/path/link is retained.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Durable evidence plus reconciled completion metadata.

findingDetails.title: Phase 4 completion claims lack a tracked follower negative-control artifact

claimAdjudication.claim: Phase 4 is marked complete without durable proof for divergence, re-entry, cap, and lock preservation.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: A checked-in fixture, measured output, or linked evidence report.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: An external manual run may exist, but the plan and unchecked goal are not linked to retained evidence.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Retained synthetic-repository evidence plus reconciled completion metadata.
